fileDesc.titleStmt: TIXALL LETTERS; OR THE CORRESPONDENCE OF THE ASTON FAMILY, AND THEIR FRIENDS, DURING THE SEVENTEENTH CENTURY. VOL. II. ED. BY CLIFFORD, ARTHUR. LONDON: LONGMAN, HURST, REES, ORME, AND BROWN AND EDINBURGH: ARCHIBALD CONSTABLE AND CO, AND JOHN BALLANTYNE AND CO. 1815.

text.p:
Mrs Aston is safely arrived, and as kindly welcomed of all, as we can make appear, till longur time furnish us with opportunity of real servis to her. It had been enough for me, to understand her a friend to Bellamore: that alone had commanded all my forces, and employed them to her best advantage, and my singular content. But experience tells me, that thing content is not to be had in this sad world, unmixed with cars and fears. For she brings the unwelcome news of your decaying strength. How can you blame me for desiring to drop away, to spare my eyes there streams? If you dye before me, I shall quickly go after you. But then, alas! what becomes of our dear girls and boys? Theirs my concern, else I could afford you all the great advantages death will bring
you. Forgive me, dear brother, that I wish, and pray, that your sojourning may bee prolonged.

You end your letter with a riddle I have not wit to find out. You say, you hope to hear I believe better of you then I did: which seems impossible; my faith concerning you cannot bee more strongly kind, no more then can my love increase.

note.value: WINEFRID THIMELBY TO HER NIECE MRS. LUMLY

text.p: These for Mrs Lumly, within tow doors of Great Turn style, in Lincolns-Inn fields, London,

Now your coronation joys are past, I expect you should crown me with the comfort of a letter, for tic a tedious time I have suffered by your silence. I confess I speak my shame, by discovering my self love, and car, to purchase my delights in hearing from you, in circumstances that should render me busied with nothing but preparation for death: for age sumons me quickly to my grave, and I thank God, I find no unwillingness to dye. But why lest I live, I must love. What did I say? Why lest I live, I must love. God forbid my love
